def find_permutations(n, pieces):
    # Create a graph where each vertex is a node and each piece is an edge
    graph = {i: [] for i in range(1, n + 1)}
    for a, b, c in pieces:
        graph[a].append((b, c))
        graph[b].append((a, c))
        graph[c].append((a, b))

    # Find the starting point of the cycle (a vertex with degree 1)
    start = None
    for node in graph:
        if len(graph[node]) == 1:
            start = node
            break

    # Reconstruct the cycle using DFS
    visited = set()
    cycle = []

    def dfs(node):
        visited.add(node)
        cycle.append(node)
        for neighbor, _ in graph[node]:
            if neighbor not in visited:
                dfs(neighbor)

    dfs(start)

    # Create the permutation p
    p = cycle

    # Create the permutation q
    q = []
    used = set()
    for i in range(n - 2):
        for j, (a, b, c) in enumerate(pieces):
            if (a, b, c) not in used and (p[i] in (a, b, c) and p[i + 1] in (a, b, c)):
                q.append(j + 1)
                used.add((a, b, c))
                break

    return p, q
